rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects unsigned DLLs loaded from user Temp directory by rundll32, common in Cobalt Strike payloads"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $s1 = "beacon.dll" nocase
        $s2 = "Start" ascii wide
        $s3 = { 6A 00 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? } // Common API call pattern
    condition:
        $s1 and $s2 and $s3 and
        filename matches /\\Temp\\.*\.dll$/i and
        not is_signed() and
        process_name() == "rundll32.exe"
}

arguments.rule_content:
title: Mass File Encryption - Exclude Known Legitimate Tools
id: 5a7c8d9e-f0b1-4c2d-8e3f-4a5b6c7d8e9f
description: Detect mass file encryption events, excluding known legitimate encryption software like VeraCrypt, BitLocker, etc.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1486/
author: SOC Team
logsource:
    category: file_event
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: 'file_write'
        file_extension: '\\.aes|\\.enc|\\.locked'
        file_size|gte: 1048576
        # High-entropy files indicative of encryption
    time_window: 5m
    condition: selection | count() by user, host > 10
    # Exclusion: Known legitimate encryption tools
    exclusion:
        process_name: 
            - 'veracrypt.exe'
            - 'diskcryptor.exe'
            - 'restore_tool.exe'
        command_line|contains:
            - '--encrypt-backup'
            - '/mode:backup'
level: high
